content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to keep the operating hours value (OT) after downloading a new program? Thanks.
If you want to monitor running hours, it’s possible. Hope this helps.

I think you’re asking about keeping the running hours retentive after downloading changes. There was a workaround posted before by an expert, but I don’t have access to the configuration software right now. Try searching this conference for the term 'retentive' and you should find several examples.

No, when a program is transmitted from PC to the controller, the operating hours counter gets overwritten. You can restore the counter manually by entering the current meter reading as the start time in the counter settings before transferring the program.
I suspected this wasn’t possible, since the manual is quite clear. It’s unfortunate, as working hours for the machine are lost after a change. How can the hours counter be reset manually? Thanks.

I didn’t mean manual reset, but manual entry of the counter value. Before transferring the program: make a note of the current meter reading, for example 65127. Open your project file, select the hours counter, right-click for properties, and then enter the noted value in the 'Start time' field of the popup. Then transfer the program; the counter will continue from the entered start time.

Hi, if you download a new or modified program to the controller and there’s a program using the operating hours counter, you’ll get a warning during download. If you want to keep the counted hours, read out the value from the controller and enter it into the new program as the 'Start time for OT' in the hours counter settings. Check my example images. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated that the hours counter in the system does not retain accumulated operating hour values after downloading a new program. The default action erases the counter, causing users to lose machine hours data unless they manually record and re-enter the value before program transfer. This manual process creates confusion and is considered unintuitive and prone to errors.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the hours counter to maintain its value across program downloads, without the need for manual input or value restoration steps.
